name: litert-google-tensor
description: Compiles LiteRT (.tflite) models ahead-of-time for Google Tensor TPUs (Tensor G5 on Pixel 10, Tensor G6 on Pixel 11) locally on Linux x86_64 or on Google Colab (--colab on macOS, Windows, or ARM hosts), benchmarks them on a USB-attached Pixel with LiteRT's benchmark_model (NPU latency, peak memory, TPU tile time, TPU energy, optional CPU baseline), and packages compiled models for an Android Gradle app as a Google Play AI pack with the Tensor NPU runtime module and a Kotlin loader, applies it to the app and verifies it on a Pixel. Use when the user asks to compile, AOT-compile, or prepare a .tflite model for the Pixel TPU/NPU, check whether a .tflite is already Tensor-compiled, measure on-device NPU performance of a compiled model, or package or deploy a compiled model into their Android app (or replace the one it ships). Don't use for Qualcomm, MediaTek, or Samsung NPUs, GPU-only benchmarking, LiteRT-LM or LLM (.litertlm) models, on-device JIT compilation, non-Gradle builds, or publishing to Google Play.
author: google
